script:
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "DualToggleGUI"
ScreenGui.Parent = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 160)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.3, 0)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Draggable = true
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
Title.Text = "Event Spammer GUI"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Title.TextScaled = true
Title.Parent = Frame

local GravityLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
GravityLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 30)
GravityLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40)
GravityLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
GravityLabel.Text = "Gravity Spam:"
GravityLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
GravityLabel.TextScaled = true
GravityLabel.Parent = Frame

local GravityToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
GravityToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 30)
GravityToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0, 40)
GravityToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
GravityToggle.Text = "OFF"
GravityToggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
GravityToggle.TextScaled = true
GravityToggle.Parent = Frame

local RebirthLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
RebirthLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 30)
RebirthLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 80)
RebirthLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
RebirthLabel.Text = "Rebirth Spam:"
RebirthLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
RebirthLabel.TextScaled = true
RebirthLabel.Parent = Frame

local RebirthToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
RebirthToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 30)
RebirthToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0, 80)
RebirthToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
RebirthToggle.Text = "OFF"
RebirthToggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
RebirthToggle.TextScaled = true
RebirthToggle.Parent = Frame

local Close = Instance.new("TextButton")
Close.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
Close.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -30)
Close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 0, 0)
Close.Text = "Close"
Close.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Close.TextScaled = true
Close.Parent = Frame

local gravityRunning = false
local rebirthRunning = false

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(0.1) do
		if gravityRunning then
			local args1 = {
				[1] = "Gravity",
				[2] = -5000000
			}
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ShopBought:FireServer(unpack(args1))
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(0.1) do
		if rebirthRunning then
			local args2 = {
				[1] = -1000000,
				[2] = 8088212
			}
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").RebirthEvent:FireServer(unpack(args2))
		end
	end
end)

GravityToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	gravityRunning = not gravityRunning
	GravityToggle.Text = gravityRunning and "ON" or "OFF"
	GravityToggle.BackgroundColor3 = gravityRunning and Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
end)

RebirthToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	rebirthRunning = not rebirthRunning
	RebirthToggle.Text = rebirthRunning and "ON" or "OFF"
	RebirthToggle.BackgroundColor3 = rebirthRunning and Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
end)

Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)
